source_snapshot.items: EC.2_PCIe link up and NVIDIA device enumeration
source_snapshot.procedure: Verify recipe; source requests log clearing; run NVQual Test #2; collect results/photos and inspect post-test logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: All items should be passed without system hang or reboot.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended and 15 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; requires NVIDIA PCIe/GPU qualification tooling and mentions an operator for possible power cycles, with per-iteration link/device evidence.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; held Pending for exact Test #2 manifest, topology/identity set, iterations/control boundary, evidence and recovery.

old_problem: NVQual Test #2 is not defined by the row beyond link-up and NVIDIA enumeration. Counts or final filtered output can hide swapped, missing or temporarily absent GPUs, downtrained links, earlier resets and AER; clearing logs would destroy relevant baseline evidence.
disposition_reason: The source purpose and no-hang/no-reboot oracle are clear. Exact vendor manifest, HGX identity/topology matrix, iteration and any reset/power semantics are runtime Project Configuration. ED safety rules require preserving rather than clearing baseline logs and prohibit inventing control actions not present in the pinned Test #2 revision.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2122, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; row 2123 is already final-audit baseline sequence 86, and actual next formal Pending row Functionality 2124 / Wistron-HGX NV PVP HW-00002-V002 / a022e49c6eae8f2d was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
The case is NVQual Test #2 link-up plus complete NVIDIA enumeration, not merely a device count or one lspci/nvidia-smi snapshot.
Bind the pinned Test #2 manifest and complete expected GPU/root-port/switch/retimer/BDF/device-ID/serial/UUID/link generation-width matrix before execution.
Preserve and hash existing dmesg/journal/AER/BMC/SEL/NVIDIA evidence; do not clear logs merely to create a zero baseline.
For every approved iteration compare full expected-versus-observed identities and links, record tool result, control action, settle timeline and fresh health/error deltas before the next iteration.
Do not add a reset or power cycle solely because DeepSeek mentions it; if the vendor manifest includes one, distinguish reset from warm/cold/AC/DC semantics and require separate point authorization.
Stop on missing/extra/misbound device, wrong/downtrained path, hang, unplanned reboot/reset, disqualifying error, evidence gap or safety anomaly; no filtering or retry.
No NVQual, enumeration query, reset, power cycle, log clearing, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Identity-complete HGX NVQual Test #2 link-up and enumeration
test_case.purpose: Run the approved NVQual Test #2 and prove every configured boundary returns the complete expected NVIDIA device/topology identity set at approved link state without hang, unplanned reboot/reset or disqualifying errors.
required_package: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual Test #2 package, license, manifest/configuration and firmware/driver compatibility
Approved iteration count, settle deadline, tool fields and explicit reset/power scope if any
Persistent baseline/iteration evidence store with first-fault interlock
Dedicated idle HGX SUT, BMC/console, stable power/cooling and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Export/hash rather than clear baseline logs and inventories. After point approval run only the pinned NVQual Test #2 iterations and control boundaries; for each, durably capture the complete expected-versus-observed PCIe/NVIDIA identity set, link generation/width, tool result, timestamps and error/health deltas before another action. Stop on first mismatch or gap; do not filter, reset, power-cycle or retry unless that exact action is separately approved.
test_case.expected_result: Every approved iteration has all and only expected NVIDIA identities mapped to the correct paths and required link generation/width, all Test #2 items accepted, no hang or unplanned reboot/reset, no disqualifying new errors, and approved final inventory/topology/health.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until Test #2 manifest, identity matrix, iterations/control scope, link/error limits and recovery are approved. PASS requires complete accepted evidence for every iteration. FAIL on missing/extra/misbound identity, downtrain, hang, unplanned reset/reboot, disqualifying error or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED; retries cannot erase failure.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact Test #2 revision, complete target identities/topology, iteration/control policy and recovery are signed.
Preserve existing evidence; never clear logs simply for baseline creation.
Any reset or power operation requires its own exact semantics and point authorization; otherwise it is prohibited.
Stop without filtering or retry on first inventory/link/platform/evidence anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, owner-approved Test #2 manifest/configuration and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities and signed full BDF/device-ID/serial/UUID/path/link matrix
Hashed pre-test raw lspci/NVIDIA/AER/kernel/BMC evidence and iteration/control contract
Per-iteration NVQual result, full expected-versus-observed identities, negotiated links, control/settle timeline and timestamps
Complete kernel/AER/NVIDIA/BMC/SEL/console/thermal/power artifacts plus photos as supporting evidence
First-fault/recovery or clean final inventory/link/host state, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On missing/extra/misbound device, downtrain, hang, unplanned reset/reboot, disqualifying error or artifact gap, inhibit subsequent iterations and preserve the first event. Do not rerun until evidence and causal state are secured; use only signed out-of-band recovery and quarantine if the expected identity/topology is not restored.
